title: HINT for Policy Analysts — briefs stay sourced
metaDescription: Keep cited instruments, options, criteria, impacts and recommendations together so assistants separate evidence from policy judgment.
h1: Your assistant drafts briefs fast. HINT keeps evidence separate from judgment.
intro: HINT keeps the issue, cited instruments, options, criteria and impacts in plain-text notes beside policy documents. Your assistant reads the declared frame before comparing options or writing a recommendation.

situations.before: A brief cites a statute and section number from memory.
situations.body: Missing authority becomes a research gap instead of a precise-looking citation.

situations.before: An impact figure appears without evidence.
situations.body: Fiscal and social estimates remain linked to the evidence and assumptions that produced them.

situations.before: Options are framed so one conclusion is inevitable.
situations.after: The same criteria apply to every option
situations.body: Trade-offs stay visible and recommendations explain where judgment begins.

example.intro: The Pawnee Policy demo grounds the Lot 48 mandate in SRC-1.
example.after: It compares options within the approved mandate and marks any absent instrument, stakeholder position or impact evidence as a gap.
example.compiled:
<mandate name="overview-1">
  Approved mandate grounded in SRC-1.
</mandate>
<source name="SRC-1">../../sources/approved.md</source>

never: Cite an unverified instrument or provision.
State an impact figure without a source.
Invent a stakeholder position or use partisan framing.
disclaimer: HINT supports policy analysis, not legal advice or democratic authority. Applicable law, consultation and accountable decision-making remain external.

faq.a: None by default. You declare the instruments and sources that govern the policy area.
No. It structures cited policy context and identifies gaps for qualified review.
Declare a neutral style, common evaluation criteria and prohibited framing; reviewers still judge whether the analysis is balanced.

keywordDescriptions.issue: Defines the policy question and its boundary.
keywordDescriptions.mandate: Names who requested the analysis and for what decision.
keywordDescriptions.regulation: Identifies a cited legal or regulatory instrument.
keywordDescriptions.provision: Records the exact cited section that applies.
keywordDescriptions.option: Defines one alternative with a stable identifier.
keywordDescriptions.impact: Records an effect, dimension and supporting source.
keywordDescriptions.tradeoff: Separates competing effects without hiding judgment.
keywordDescriptions.recommendation: States a conclusion together with its justification.
